lines.en: Hi! Is this your first baseball game?
lines.pt: Oi! Este é o seu primeiro jogo de beisebol?

lines.en: Yes. I do not know baseball well. Can you explain the rules?
lines.pt: Sim. Eu não conheço beisebol bem. Você pode explicar as regras?

lines.en: Sure. One player throws, and the other player hits the ball.
lines.pt: Claro. Um jogador joga, e o outro jogador bate na bola.

lines.en: And who is that man in black?
lines.pt: E quem é aquele homem de preto?

lines.en: He is the umpire. He says strike or ball.
lines.pt: Ele é o árbitro. Ele diz strike ou bola.

lines.en: I see. Where is the scoreboard?
Look at the big screen in the outfield. It is three to two.
lines.pt: Olhe a tela grande no campo externo. Está três a dois.

lines.en: Thanks. Are there hotdogs and peanuts here?
lines.pt: Obrigada. Tem cachorro-quente e amendoim aqui?

lines.en: Yes, the vendor is coming. Raise your hand.
lines.pt: Sim, o vendedor está chegando. Levante a mão.

lines.en: Okay. Who is that big bird on the field?
lines.pt: Ok. Quem é aquele pássaro grande no campo?

lines.en: That is our mascot. Everyone loves him!
lines.pt: É o nosso mascote. Todo mundo gosta dele!

pages.title: Strike, ball and peanuts · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny Sunday afternoon at the ballpark in Chicago. Thousands of fans sit in the bleachers. Ana is here with a cap and a new mitt. She does not know the game, but she is curious. An older man named Walt sits next to her. He wears a blue shirt and holds a small flag.
“Hi! Is this your first baseball game?” says Walt. “Yes. I do not know baseball well. Can you explain the rules?” says Ana. “Sure. One player throws, and the other player hits the ball.” says Walt.
